# GunSite South Africa

> South Africa's premier firearms, tactical, and hunting discussion community featuring forums, product reviews, and legal resources.

GunSite South Africa serves as a comprehensive hub for firearms enthusiasts, hunters, and tactical professionals in South Africa. The site combines active discussion forums with curated content on firearms products, industry news, and essential legal documentation including the Firearms Control Act.

## Key Topics

- South Africa
- Firearms
- Hunting
- Tactical Gear
- Firearms Control Act
- Concealed Carry
- Firearms Legislation
- Product Reviews
- Firearms News
- Firearm Licenses
- Vortex Optics
- Beretta
- Colt
- Tikka
- Self-Defense

## Core Community

- [Homepage](http://gunsite.co.za): Homepage for South Africa's firearms and hunting discussion community
- [Discussion Forums](http://www.gunsite.co.za/forums/forum.php): Main forum discussion area for firearms and hunting enthusiasts
- [Content Hub](http://www.gunsite.co.za/content): South Africa's firearms, tactical & hunting discussion forums hub
- [About Us](http://www.gunsite.co.za/content/about-us): GunSite South Africa's mission and history as firearms community forum

## Legal Resources & Legislation

- [Firearms Control Act, 2000 (Act No. 60 of 2000)](http://www.gunsite.co.za/content/resources/firearms-control-act-2000-act-no-60-of-2000-updated-to-31-jan-2015): Full text of South African Firearms Control Act 60 of 2000 legislation
- [Firearms control legislation – South African](http://www.gunsite.co.za/content/resources/firearm-licence/firearms-control-act-2000-south-africa): South African firearms control legislation and legal amendments
- [Firearms Amnesty – Guidelines for Licence Application](http://www.gunsite.co.za/content/resources/firearm-licence/firearms-amnesty-guidelines-procedure-to-process-a-firearm-licence-application): Procedure and guidelines for firearms amnesty licence applications
